question: Which of the following is NOT the correct match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chloroplast- Altman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first explicit definition of a chloroplast was given by **Hugo von Mohl **in 1837 as discrete bodies within the green plant cell.
 
• Chloroplast is an organelle that contains the **photosynthesis **pigment chlorophyll that captures sunlight and converts it into useful energy, thereby, releasing oxygen from water.
 
• Chloroplast is found in all **Green plants and algae**.
 
• They are** food producers** of plants.
 
• These are found in the **guard cell** located in the leaves of the plants.
 
• They contain a high concentration of **chlorophyll **that traps sunlight.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fc2a122e319bf3420f35355465e6a84d79eae3ae43af465168b70eda4f92416.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lysosomes:**

 
 
• **​**These are membrane-bound vesicular structures formed by the process of packaging in the Golgi apparatus.
 
• These are called "Suicidal bags" because of their phagocytic activity.
 
 
 
• **Mitochondria**:
 
 
• It is a double-layered cell organelle in which the outer layer is porous and the inner layers folded upon themselves are known to be cristae.
 
• It is also called the** Power House of the Cell**.
 
 
 
• **Ribosomes**:
 
 
• They are composed of ribonucleic acid and protein and are not surrounded by any membrane.
 
• They are the site of protein synthesis.
